verdict.rationale: Weave's marketing page says signals automatically classify agent interactions and that alerts route results through Slack and trigger webhook automations. Release notes also mention creating custom signals for behaviors you define, which together form a basic event-to-action rule mechanism. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how to define alert rules and their conditions, which actions are supported beyond Slack and webhooks, how webhook automations are configured, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Alerts route what matters through Slack notifications and trigger webhook automations, turning every production insight into a fast iteration.
Create a custom W\&B Weave signal to tag agent turns for a behavior you define.
Built-in and custom signals automatically capture and classify agent interactions, so you always know how your agents are behaving.
